title: The Sound of Geese Overhead
short_teaser: Migrating geese pass over Iowa in shifting formations, responding to weather, daylight, food, and one another.
story: Migrating geese pass over Iowa in shifting formations, responding to weather, daylight, food, and one another. Their calls turn an ordinary sky into a reminder that movement is happening on a much larger scale. Wonder often arrives through a familiar event noticed at the right moment. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Wonder often arrives through a familiar event noticed at the right moment. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
spark_application: Spend five quiet minutes noticing something that creates awe, surprise, or delight. Save one sentence about what shifted in your perspective. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
